claims.assertion: Swaruu describes stars as wormhole exits paired with black-hole entrances; each toroidal portal system may have multiple frequency-dependent routes.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says Taygetan ships generate custom wormholes, using propulsion only for maneuvers; natural black-hole-to-star transit is lower technology.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Inside the ether, Yazhi says ship-frequency changes can shift exit stars; black-hole navigation is harder than solar portals.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Anéeka says sunspots open cyclical, predictable ship portals; inactive spots can make nearby transit difficult or stop it.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
